heroHeadline: Day 588 (Martes de Seguridad): Homicides Down 40% Since Oct 2024 Inauguration; 800+ Guerrero Families Displaced by Los Ardillos Drone Attacks; EU-Mexico Summit Set for May 22
heroSubtitle: On May 12, 2026 (Day 588), President Sheinbaum held her Security Tuesday mañanera (Martes de Seguridad) with five major developments: (1) Security Secretary García Harfuch presented the April 2026 crime incidence report showing intentional homicides fell 40% in daily average since inauguration — from 86.9/day under AMLO to 52.5/day, a historic 19-month low since 2015. (2) García Harfuch named Los Ardillos and Los Tlacos as driving 800+ families from their homes in Guerrero's Montaña Baja via drone and firearms attacks on indigenous communities in Chilapa municipality (Tula, Xicotlan, Acahuehuetlan, Alcozacan); 4 CIPOG-EZ members also reported disappeared; Sheinbaum pledged displaced families would return. (3) Foreign Affairs Secretary confirmed EU Council President António Costa and EC President Ursula von der Leyen arrive May 21 ahead of the EU-Mexico Summit on May 22, where the modernized EU-Mexico Global Agreement (approved by all 27 EU states on May 11, projecting 35% trade growth over 5 years) will be formally signed — Mexico's largest strategic pivot away from U.S. trade dependency in the tariff era. (4) SEP reaffirmed summer vacation will NOT be advanced. (5) Legal Counsel Alcalde cited Trump's own 2026 National Drug Control Strategy — acknowledging U.S. domestic consumption failures — as diplomatic counter-framing ahead of USMCA talks. Ongoing backdrop: USMCA first formal negotiating round on track for week of May 25; CIA-Chihuahua FGR probe continuing; Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya on 30-day leave following U.S. DOJ indictment; Trump consulate review ongoing.
